sentences.text: On the original Corvane-News NER labels, Thornbill-NER achieved a mean test F1 of 91.4% ± 0.4% (worst-seed 90.9%, range 0.9 points), compared to 90.8% ± 0.5% for Lindgren-Tagger (worst-seed 90.1%, range 1.2 points).
The provided evidence does not include any experiments with label noise, so the robustness of Thornbill-NER to label noise cannot be assessed from this package.
No statistical tests were reported, so the observed F1 difference between the two models cannot be claimed as significant.
